coverage_scenarios.description: Unanchored (no valid checkpoint) -> cannot certify complete -> gap.
Valid checkpoint for a different epoch -> tampered.
Checkpoint root does not identify its terminal batch -> tampered.
Checkpoint is behind the requested range -> gap.
Stored batches returned out of sequence order -> tampered.
All retained batches removed below a valid checkpoint -> truncated.
Signed but schema-invalid record cannot produce complete coverage.
Historical key lookup verifies an in-epoch producer key rotation.
Overlapping retained sequence ranges cannot be accepted history.
An invalid request is gap when no higher-precedence defect applies.
Tampering takes precedence over an invalid request.
